about.text: It derives its name from the use of milk removed 15 minutes after the usual milking. Hence the wallon verb rimoûd meaning to re-milk. This cheese weighs 200 to 500g. When it is washed with salt it gets a strong taste, and when it is washed with milk it keeps a mild taste. It is often sold in pieces.

sources.text: Land of Herve; made from second-milking milk; washed with salt (strong) or milk (mild); 200-500 g; ripening not stated. Near-relative of Herve/Floreffe
